title: 2- Sampling: Exponential distribution
text: In the Statistics Dashboard Sampling tab, repeat Exercise 1 using an Exponential distribution with mean 10. What differences do you observe compared to the Normal distribution?
answer: Compared to the Normal distribution, the Exponential distribution is skewed right. However, as sample size increases, the distribution of sample means still approaches normality (Central Limit Theorem), though it takes larger samples to achieve this compared to the already-symmetric Normal distribution.
